primary_source.citation: Luo, Gu & Zhang 2009 Journal of Systematics and Evolution 47:43-56

direct_observations: female Xylocopa preferentially buzzed short feeding stamens
vibration caused pollen from long stamens to be ejected onto the dorsal abdomen
the stigma contacted the same dorsal pollen-bearing region of the bee

supporting_source.result: short-stamen pollen is enriched in fatty-acid and protein profiles associated with selective bee foraging
